messages.subject: Re: Plots to check data quality
parts:
Dear Irirs,

I guess the main purpose of these plots, at least this is what I use them for, is to check that you are using the data you intend to use regarding the study protocol and that the amount of invalid data (non wear) is not too high. Sometimes I see that the calibration procedure was not successful in the "QC/data_quality_report.csv" and these plots help me to understand why (usually because the device was barely worn or it stopped recording data sooner than expected).

Best,
Jairo
